# Pragvance.ai

> Practical AI. Built to advance your business.

Pragvance helps you staff a Grok Bot department — roles, skills, tools, routines — and ships apps & SaaS when the work needs a product.

## Offers
- AI Workforce (primary): $99/mo on Skool — https://www.skool.com/aiworkforce
  Weekly live training to build a Grok Bot agent team. Classroom stays on Skool.
- Shadow Lab (upsell): $497 seat / $997 month — book via https://pragvance.ai/contact
  Live high-touch seats. Not a second school on this site.
- AI Assessment: free readiness assessment at /assessment
- Apps: portfolio including MinutesIntel.ai (https://minutesintel.ai); custom builds via contact

## AI Spin Up
- Page: https://pragvance.ai/spin-up (also reached from /hi and /talk-to-an-ai-agent)
- What it is: a SaaS from Pragvance.ai where any business owner gets an AI agent speaking in their voice, so a prospect tapping a social ad feels they're talking straight to the owner and ends up booked on a call.
- How it works: land from the ad; the agent starts talking; it interviews one question at a time; the prospect swaps contact details and books a call via Calendly.
- The agent always says it is an AI agent and never claims to be the owner. Voice never autoplays; "Tap to hear" plays the owner's own recording.
- Built for anyone who sells. Works for any business person selling something.
